messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 ALERT: prefills causing container restarts on pool=preload-gpu-2 (7 restarts in 6m). symptom=CUDA OOM during prefill. paging @maria (oncall) and @eng-runtime. link: https://grafana/redwood/alerts/9876

maria (oncall): on it. seeing spike in prefills ~12:02 UTC, looks correlated with 'document-upload' route.

maria (oncall): checking kube events and container logs now. tagging @tyler (sre) for node-level context.

tyler (sre): node metrics show memory pressure on GPU nodes 10 and 11, GPU mem used ~98%. OOMs are hitting the runtime prefill step (large user docs).

alex (eng-runtime): can you paste the container log for one of the restarts? need the stack.

maria (oncall): pasted logs from container prefill-78b (kube pod redwood-prefill-78b-xxxxx):
```
2026-03-15T12:03:11Z runtime ERROR: prefill failed: RuntimeError("CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.1 GiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total)")\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/app/serve/prefill.py\", line 212, in run_prefill\n    kv_cache.store_batch(batch)\n  File \"/app/serve/kv_cache.py\", line 89, in store_batch\n    torch.cuda.synchronize()\nRuntimeError: CUDA out of memory\n```

alex (eng-runtime): yep, classic prefill OOM. looks like customers are sending very long single-shot prompts (we're seeing up to ~50k tokens). prefill tries to build KV cache for entire prompt which spikes allocations.

dave (eng-infra): GPU nodes are 16GB cards. prefill bursts can push beyond that. autoscaler hasn't added capacity because surge was short.

sophia (cs): Customer A reported slow/failing responses around 12:02-12:06 UTC — they sent a single large upload + prompt. I've DM'd them asking for sample request IDs.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation idea: 1) set route-level max_prefill_tokens=8000 for 'document-upload' 2) enable streaming-prefill-trim fallback so prefill truncates gracefully 3) mark route to fallback to smaller model (8k context) for >8k inputs. anyone object?

alex (eng-runtime): +1. we can push a runtime config change to toggle prefill limits per route without code deploy. I'll prepare a hotpatch.

tyler (sre): also recommend a quick cluster-level throttle: reject prefill requests > 20k tokens with 413 and a helpful error to client while we stabilize.

dave (eng-infra): I'll add a temporary limit at the ingress proxy for the 'document-upload' path. will be live in ~3m.

maria (oncall): rolling the ingress limit now to block >20k tokens. applying route max_prefill_tokens=8000. alex, do you want me to flip streaming-trim?

alex (eng-runtime): please flip streaming-trim=true for that route. and set fallback_model=redwood-small-8k. I'll monitor OOM rate.

incident-bot: config-change: ingress rule updated by dave at 12:07:24 UTC.

maria (oncall): streaming-trim enabled, route max_prefill_tokens applied. watching logs.

tyler (sre): after the changes, we see OOM restarts drop to 0 in last 2m on affected pool. GPU mem utilization back to normal (60-70%).

sophia (cs): Customer A confirmed degraded responses stopped after 12:08 UTC. they supplied request id 0a1b2c3d for investigation.

alex (eng-runtime): good. short-term mitigations in place. proposed next steps: 1) add a hard prefill token cap in runtime to avoid unbounded KV allocations 2) implement incremental prefill (stream & evict) to handle very long docs 3) add autoscaler policy to react to prefill spikes 4) postmortem and customer-impact timeline. assigning owners in thread.

maria (oncall): handing off to alex (eng-runtime) for postmortem/cleanup. I'm out in ~20m but will stay available for handover.

alex (eng-runtime): taking ownership of postmortem. ETA for doc: EOD tomorrow. immediate action items I own: runtime prefill hard cap (PR), incremental prefill design.

alex (eng-runtime): @sophia please send Customer A a short incident note: "We experienced transient failures for large single-request uploads between 12:02-12:08 UTC due to GPU memory exhaustion during prefill. We applied rate-limits and a runtime fallback; their requests should be successful now. Postmortem and remediation plan forthcoming."

sophia (cs): will send now, cc: security if needed.

tyler (sre): meta: add an alert for prefill OOM count >3/min per pool and a synthetic test hitting large-context routes to catch regressions.

dave (eng-infra): infra action: propose upgrading GPU instance type for prefill pool to 32GB next week for capacity testing. filing infra ticket.

incident-bot: NOTE: pager acknowledged by maria at 12:05:10 UTC; incident resolved (mitigations applied) at 12:08:30 UTC.

maria (oncall): closing the immediate incident. alex, tag me in the postmortem when ready and I'll validate the timeline. good job team :thumbsup:
